name: speech-to-speech
description: Build local voice agents with open-source models
readme_excerpt: A low-latency, fully modular voice-agent pipeline: **VAD -> STT -> LLM -> TTS**, exposed through an **OpenAI Realtime-compatible WebSocket API**. Every component is swappable. The LLM slot speaks OpenAI-compatible protocols, so you can point it at a hosted provider, at HF Inference Providers, or at a vLLM or llama.cpp server on your own hardware for a fully local, fully open stack.
